title: Veterinary and One Health applications
tables: Veterinary diagnostic labs, animal hospitals, agricultural research and public-health networks.
Animal isolates and sector-specific AMR data are often fragmented and may use different policies or workflows.
AST/MIC modules; PIMS; species/sample metadata; offline mode; surveillance export; multi-site governance.
Register animal/source metadata -> execute validated veterinary AST/MIC method -> expert review -> report -> optional de-identified sector surveillance.
Traceable susceptibility result plus host, source and location metadata for approved surveillance.
Uses one technical platform while preserving sector-specific methods and governance.
Human clinical breakpoints may not apply. Veterinary standards, specimen context, privacy/ownership, farm biosecurity and epidemiological sampling design must be respected.
